info.title: Electrode
info.author: Samtendo Network
info.description: Aroma patcher for using Samtendo Network
info.details:
This is Electrode - the open-source patcher for using Samtendo Network! All changes are ephemeral, meaning you can quickly get rid of it if you'd like!

We support many games, from Splatoon, Super Smash Bros, Mario Kart 8, to even older apps like Wii U Chat!

Join our Discord here: https://discord.samtendo.net
